definition: The DEAP Gold dataset is defined by this manifest. It consists of the Bronze .dat files (physiological signals) and Silver label CSV files (XLS-corrected labels) listed below, identified by their authoritative paths and SHA-256 checksums. No physical copy of the data arrays is made. Analysis code should read from the paths listed in each entry.

summary.flag_and_retain_policy: Temp scale groups (A vs B), GSR negative values, and Temp flatlines are flagged per participant and retained unmodified. Their cause is not confirmed in available sources.

participant_ratings_xls.description: Authoritative label source; v1 mirror matched exactly; used to correct v2 inversion artefact in Silver.

summary.physiological_plausibility_not_applied: Units and preprocessing for peripheral channels (GSR, Resp, BVP, Temp) are not documented in available sources; bounds cannot be set without confirmed units.
summary.provenance: Data sourced from v2 Kaggle mirror (32 participants). v1 mirror was incomplete (12 participants) and replaced. Labels verified against participant_ratings.xls; 878 v2 inversion artefacts corrected in Silver.
